statement: The pinned Codex turn loop checks context limits before and after sampling and can replace history through local or remote compaction before resuming the same turn.

display_text.zh-CN: 固定版本的 Codex turn loop 会在采样前后检查上下文限制，并可通过本地或远程 compaction 替换 history，然后继续同一 turn。
display_text.en: The pinned Codex turn loop checks context limits before and after sampling and can replace history through local or remote compaction before resuming the same turn.

evidence.title: Codex pre- and mid-turn compaction routing

notes: No quality or losslessness claim is made; the native experiment needed to characterize behavior is still missing.
